types.name: DesktopBackend
types.summary: Default desktop backend. MonoGame remains behind the runtime host boundary.

types.name: MonoGameWindow
types.summary: Hosts the game loop in a MonoGame window and forwards resizing and drawing events.

types.name: AssetId
types.summary: Persistent content identity, independent of its filename and runtime resource lifetime.

types.name: AssetLease<T>
types.summary: An owned borrow. Retain explicitly for another borrower; dispose each lease once.

types.name: AssetRef<T>
types.summary: A typed persistent reference; the asset service validates its registered runtime kind.

types.name: FontData
types.summary: Immutable single-face SFNT data. Reading it does not promise shaping or glyph coverage.

types.name: IAssetSource
types.summary: Opens independent caller-owned streams by relative logical key. No filesystem is assumed.

types.name: TextureData
types.summary: Immutable CPU RGBA8 pixels in top-to-bottom row order; no implicit GPU transfer conversion.

types.name: CapabilityIdentity
types.summary: Identifies one immutable capability snapshot of one service owner.

types.name: ComputeDescription
types.summary: Requirements for the existing single RGBA32F-image compute path, not general GPU compute.

types.name: FeatureDeclaration
types.summary: Backend discovery result, supplied once when creating a snapshot.

types.name: FeatureSupport
types.summary: A pure support result. Operational availability is reported separately by the service.

types.name: GraphicsCapabilities
types.summary: One device generation's capabilities. Only the owning controller changes availability.

types.name: GraphicsCapabilityController
types.summary: Owned by a backend or headless scene. Consumers receive its read-only capability service.

types.name: GraphicsFeature<TDescription, TLimits>
types.summary: Optional facility with immutable support/limits and a side-effect-free descriptor check.

types.name: GraphicsLimits
types.summary: Limits queried from the active device. Null means unreported, never unlimited.

types.name: ServiceCapability
types.summary: Immutable operation support with separately refreshed operational availability.

types.name: ServiceCapabilityController
types.summary: One owner-thread service lifetime. Support queries perform no I/O and never prompt or start work.

types.name: ServiceFeature
types.summary: Optional authoring and installation facilities, queried independently of graphics/player support.

types.name: Camera2D
types.summary: A 2D camera. Pan with Position, zoom in with Zoom above 1, and tilt with Rotation.

types.name: Camera3D
types.summary: A perspective camera that looks from Position toward Target. Units are world units and angles are radians; Y is up.

types.name: Chunk3D
types.summary: 16x16x16 voxel chunk of 3D tiles.

types.name: Circle2D
types.summary: Draws the entity as a circle centered on its Transform2D position. Pair it with a Material for color and light.

types.name: Collision2D
types.summary: A collision box for your own collision logic; the engine stores it but does not resolve collisions.

types.name: Material
types.summary: How an entity looks and interacts with light. Emissive makes it a light source; Albedo decides how much light it blocks and what color the light takes when passing through.

types.name: Mesh3D
types.summary: Draws a mesh with a base color at the entity's Transform3D. Many entities can share one mesh.

types.name: MotionTrackable
types.summary: Add this component to entities that need motion vector tracking. Contains a fixed-size circular buffer for position history - no allocations.

types.name: Movement2D
types.summary: Velocity and acceleration. Add Movement2DSystem to the scene and entities with this component move on their own.

types.name: Movement3D
types.summary: Velocity and acceleration in 3D. Add Movement3DSystem to the scene and entities with this component move on their own.

types.name: Rectangle2D
types.summary: Draws the entity as a rectangle whose top-left corner sits at its Transform2D position. Pair it with a Material.

types.name: RigidBody2D
types.summary: Mass for your own physics code; the engine stores it but does not simulate it.

types.name: SurfaceEmission
types.summary: Makes a 3D surface glow with HDR brightness for the path tracer. Values above 1 are brighter than white.

types.name: Tile3D
types.summary: Single tile identifier for 3D tilesets.

types.name: Transform2D
types.summary: Where a 2D entity is, how it is rotated and scaled, and which layer it draws on.

types.name: Transform3D
types.summary: Where a 3D entity is, how it is rotated (radians) and how it is scaled.

types.name: Triangle2D
types.summary: Draws the entity as a triangle at its Transform2D position, filled or as an outline.

types.name: ArcGizmo
types.summary: Position, angular span, and appearance of a queued diagnostic arc.

types.name: CircleGizmo
types.summary: Position, radius, and appearance of a queued diagnostic circle.

types.name: GizmosRenderer
types.summary: Draws debug lines, circles, rectangles and labels over the scene. Queue them every frame from Render or LateRender; they clear on the next update.

types.name: Inspector
types.summary: Displays in-game diagnostic windows and controls for inspecting and tuning a scene.

types.name: InspectorTheme
types.summary: Color palette for an Inspector theme. All 15 slots must be set.

types.name: LineGizmo
types.summary: Endpoints, color, and thickness of a queued diagnostic line.

types.name: MenuItemType
types.summary: Type of menu bar item.

types.name: PerformanceMonitor
types.summary: Samples process and GPU metrics and displays frame-performance history.

types.name: RectGizmo
types.summary: Bounds and appearance of a queued diagnostic rectangle.

types.name: TextGizmo
types.summary: Text, position, and appearance of a queued diagnostic label.

types.name: WidgetType
types.summary: Available widget types for Inspector windows.

types.name: WindowCategory
types.summary: Grouping in View: system tools first, then scene windows below a separator.

types.name: WorkspaceMode
types.summary: Floating inspector windows or a docked editor surrounding a game preview.

types.name: ContentDiagnostic
types.summary: Structured project/content failure or notice; source locations are one-based when present.

types.name: EngineLog
types.summary: Thread-safe, bounded engine diagnostics retained for the Inspector debugger.

types.name: Archetype
types.summary: Archetype stores entities with identical component combinations. Components are stored in contiguous arrays for cache-friendly iteration.

types.name: Component
types.summary: Marker interface for data stored on ECS entities.

types.name: ComponentDescriptionAttribute
types.summary: Provides a human-readable component description for the inspector.

types.name: ECS
types.summary: Holds a scene's entities, their components and its systems. Create entities, attach plain-data components, and run parallel queries over everything that matches. Structural mutation belongs to the creation thread. Queries may be called from a background coordinator and serialize with structural mutation; callbacks may edit their supplied component references or schedule deletion.

types.name: ECS.QueryAction<T1>
types.summary: Called for each matching entity with the worker index, the entity ID and a reference to its component.

types.name: ECS.QueryAction<T1, T2>
types.summary: Called for each matching entity with the worker index, the entity ID and references to its two components.

types.name: ECS.QueryAction<T1, T2, T3>
types.summary: Called for each matching entity with the worker index, the entity ID and references to its three components.

types.name: EntityRef
types.summary: An opaque reference to one incarnation of an entity in one world. Validate through the owning ECS before use. The default value is invalid; copying a reference does not retain the world.

types.name: IGameObject
types.summary: Lifecycle callbacks for scene initialization, simulation, and drawing.

types.name: PagedBitSet
types.summary: Ultra-fast paged bitset for tracking entity active state. Uses 1 bit per entity instead of ~24+ bytes for HashSet entry. Power-of-2 sizes enable bit operations instead of division.

types.name: PagedBitSet.EntityEnumerator
types.summary: Iterates the set entity IDs in a paged bit set.

types.name: SpatialIndex
types.summary: Indexes entity positions for exact, regional, and nearest-neighbor queries.

types.name: SystemCollection
types.summary: A reusable recipe that registers fresh systems in each scene's ECS.

types.name: CameraEditor
types.summary: Editor navigation in camera-local axes, independent of input devices and rendering views.

types.name: ComponentEditor
types.summary: On-demand editing of public component data; never stores archetype references.

types.name: LightFactory
types.summary: One-line helpers for adding lights to a 2D scene lit by HRCGI.

types.name: SystemCollections
types.summary: Reusable system collections for scene setup.

types.name: VectorExtensions
types.summary: Component-wise vector arithmetic and mapping helpers.

types.name: BlendState
types.summary: Immutable, backend-independent BlendState description. Native resources belong to the renderer.

types.name: DepthStencilState
types.summary: Immutable, backend-independent DepthStencilState description. Native resources belong to the renderer.

types.name: Effect
types.summary: A compiled shader owned by the renderer cache. Release through Renderer.ReleaseShader.

types.name: EffectParameter
types.summary: Typed shader inputs. Array conversions and storage belong to the backend.

types.name: EffectParameters
types.summary: Named parameters; an absent optional parameter returns null.

types.name: FontFace
types.summary: A sized font borrowed from its family. It becomes invalid when that family is disposed.

types.name: IFontLoader
types.summary: Loads a caller-owned family from a backend-relative asset path.

types.name: IGeometryBackend
types.summary: Render-thread submission of triangle geometry to the currently bound target.

types.name: IGraphicsAssetLoader
types.summary: Loads a caller-owned Radiant resource handle. Implementations may share underlying content, but disposing one handle must not invalidate another consumer's handle. Effect parameters must be independent between loads. Caching belongs to the caller.

types.name: IGraphicsBackend
types.summary: Per-renderer graphics session. The renderer owns this session; it owns and disposes all command adapters. Resources returned by its factories are disposed by their callers. No windowing framework or native device is required by this contract.

types.name: IGraphicsCommands
types.summary: Synchronous render-thread commands. All resources must belong to this backend.

types.name: IGraphicsResource
types.summary: A backend-owned resource. Dispose caller-created resources before their renderer.

types.name: IGraphicsResourceFactory
types.summary: Factory contract for graphics backends; all signatures use Radiant types.

types.name: IShapeBatchBackend
types.summary: Render-thread submission boundary. Consume the array synchronously; do not retain it.

types.name: RasterizerState
types.summary: Immutable, backend-independent RasterizerState description. Native resources belong to the renderer.

types.name: RenderTarget2D
types.summary: A drawable image with backend-selected depth and sample configuration.

types.name: SamplerState
types.summary: Immutable, backend-independent SamplerState description. Native resources belong to the renderer.

types.name: SurfaceFormat
types.summary: Portable, uncompressed pixel layouts supported by Radiant.

types.name: Texture2D
types.summary: A 2D image contract implementable by any graphics backend. Create through Renderer.

types.name: IInputSource
types.summary: Captures input once per variable update, on the loop thread. Text must be drained exactly once.

types.name: InputFrame
types.summary: Provides the keyboard, mouse and text state shared by a scene's callbacks for one update.

types.name: InputSnapshot
types.summary: One backend sample, including committed UTF-16 text since the previous capture.

types.name: Key
types.summary: Logical keys understood by Radiant. Values are independent of any platform key codes.

types.name: KeyboardState
types.summary: Immutable, allocation-free key snapshot. Default means no keys are held.

types.name: MouseState
types.summary: Mouse position in window pixels, buttons and wheel totals. The wheel moves 120 units per notch.

types.name: NullInputSource
types.summary: Default input for runtimes without input devices.

types.name: Color
types.summary: An RGBA color with 0–255 channels. Integer constructors take bytes; float constructors take 0–1 and clamp.

types.name: MatrixMath
types.summary: Backend-independent matrix operations using row-vector transforms (scale * rotation * translation).

types.name: Point
types.summary: An integer coordinate or size, independent of the graphics backend.

types.name: Rectangle
types.summary: Integer bounds. Point containment excludes the right and bottom edges.

types.name: GameServerDescriptor
types.summary: Directory entry describing a discoverable game server.

types.name: NetworkClient
types.summary: Owns a TCP connection and routes received messages to its game server.

types.name: NetworkManager
types.summary: Client for registering and discovering servers through the HTTP directory.

types.name: NetworkMessage
types.summary: Typed JSON payload exchanged between game clients and servers.

types.name: ServerRegisterResponse
types.summary: Result of registering a game server with the directory.

types.name: IProjectModule
types.summary: Explicit project registration entry point. Desktop Play creates one module per code generation; configuration and disposal run on the engine owner thread. Opening a project does not execute it.

types.name: ProjectModuleAttribute
types.summary: Selects the project's single module without scanning arbitrary assembly types. The desktop loader requires a public, concrete, nongeneric module in this assembly with a public parameterless constructor.

types.name: ColorVertex
types.summary: A position and RGBA8 color with a 16-byte GPU layout.

types.name: DenoiserFrame
types.summary: Linear HDR input and aligned guides. SingleSample is unaccumulated radiance, not the progressive mean.

types.name: ICameraView
types.summary: A view's camera binding, exposed to generic editor tools.

types.name: IComputeRenderer
types.summary: Optional compute commands. Backends without compute inherit an explicit unsupported result.

types.name: IComputeShader
types.summary: Optional compute kernel with a session-owned output image.

types.name: IDenoiserBackend
types.summary: Per-view denoiser extension. Backends own their resources and report actual runtime support.

types.name: IPathTraceSession
types.summary: Optional accelerated path tracing with a session-owned Radiant output.

types.name: IRasterGeometry
types.summary: Geometry submission for lighting before sample resolve. The bound effect provides Meshes/Shapes techniques.

types.name: IRenderSource
types.summary: Named live outputs. Providers survive resize; missing optional buffers return null.

types.name: IRenderer
types.summary: Draws everything on screen: shader passes, batched shapes, sprites, text and render targets. Every scene and system gets one through its Renderer property, and most calls return the renderer so a pass reads as a single chain.

types.name: ITraceDenoiserSession
types.summary: Optional reconstruction of signals produced by a compatible tracing session.

types.name: ITraceGeometry
types.summary: Opt-in world geometry adapter. Ray tracing never requires per-entity 3D data in a 2D game.

types.name: IViewportCamera2D
types.summary: A renderer-owned 2D viewport that editor tools can pan without an ECS camera entity.

types.name: ImageSystem
types.summary: Base image-processing stage that exposes its output and named diagnostic buffers.

types.name: Mesh
types.summary: Immutable indexed triangle mesh. GPU copies are owned by each Renderer.

types.name: MeshVertex
types.summary: Backend-independent mesh vertex: position, normal, UV; 32 tightly packed bytes.

types.name: RenderView
types.summary: Backend-independent viewport metrics, resolution scale and fitted 2D coordinates.

types.name: Renderer
types.summary: Fluent Radiant rendering API providing shader management, render targets, and fullscreen quad drawing for post-processing effects.

types.name: RoundedCorners
types.summary: Flags for which corners to round in DrawRoundedRect. Combinable for partial rounding.

types.name: Shape
types.summary: GPU instanced shape data. Use with Renderer.DrawShape() for efficient batched rendering.

types.name: ShapeCollection
types.summary: CPU-only shape storage and per-worker collection. Each worker owns its slot; initialize, resize and merge only after joining workers. Sorting is ascending Z.

types.name: TraceBvh
types.summary: Median-split, preorder BVH with escape links: stackless GPU traversal, no fixed triangle limit.

types.name: TraceBvh.Node
types.summary: Bounding volume and child or triangle range in the tracing hierarchy.

types.name: TraceCamera
types.summary: View and projection data used to generate rays and track camera changes.

types.name: TraceSceneBuffer
types.summary: Owns a GPU copy of an ITraceGeometry hierarchy for stages that bind this buffer.

types.name: TraceTriangle
types.summary: Triangle positions and surface properties consumed by ray tracing.

types.name: GameClient
types.summary: Starts your game: opens the window, runs the loop and cleans up when the player closes it.

types.name: GameLoop
types.summary: Coordinates scene transitions, fixed updates, rendering, and frame pacing.

types.name: GameServer
types.summary: Accepts TCP clients and dispatches or broadcasts game messages.

types.name: HeadlessBackend
types.summary: Runs a finite, deterministic simulation without a window, graphics device or render callbacks.

types.name: IAboutWindow
types.summary: Optional host capability for showing the engine's modal About panel.

types.name: IRuntimeBackend
types.summary: Creates an independent platform session for a Radiant application.

types.name: IRuntimeHost
types.summary: Platform lifecycle boundary. The host owns presentation resources; GameLoop owns scenes and ECS scheduling. Invoke loop callbacks on one thread. Dispose the loop before the host. Graphics sessions use the independent Radiant graphics backend contracts.

types.name: IWindow
types.summary: Application-facing window operations, independent of the desktop toolkit.

types.name: LoadingProgress
types.summary: A real startup or update milestone. Null completion means the amount of work is unknown.

types.name: RuntimeBackends
types.summary: Chooses the platform integration without coupling the core assembly to one implementation.

types.name: SceneSessionManager
types.summary: Latest-request-wins scene preparation. Only GameLoop's owner boundary creates or publishes a scene.

types.name: WindowOptions
types.summary: How the game window opens. The world keeps the same coordinates whatever size the window has.

types.name: PreparedScene
types.summary: Single-use prepared ownership. Dispose when abandoning; instantiate transfers its leases exactly once.

types.name: SceneComponentValue<T>
types.summary: A predecoded value and its explicitly declared instance-local reference fixups.

types.name: SceneData
types.summary: Immutable, portable scene description. Fields contain data, never CLR type names or executable YAML.

types.name: SceneEntityMap
types.summary: Complete, read-only mapping for one instance. Authored UUIDs never become raw ECS integers.

types.name: SceneFields
types.summary: Helpers for explicitly rejecting unknown component fields instead of silently losing authored data.

types.name: SceneId
types.summary: A typed persistent scene identity, independent of runtime instances.

types.name: SceneInstance
types.summary: Owns only entities and leases created by one additive instance. Unload on the world's owner thread.

types.name: SceneLoader
types.summary: CPU preflight followed by explicit owner-thread additive instantiation. Full scene replacement/lifecycle is not provided.

types.name: ScenePreparationContext
types.summary: Owns every dependency lease acquired during preflight. Decoders receive values, not ownership.

types.name: SceneRegistry
types.summary: Explicit AOT-safe schema registrations. No assemblies or CLR names are loaded from scene files.

types.name: AntiAliaser
types.summary: Per-view post AA plus supersample resolve. Geometry MSAA/SSAA belongs to RasterSampler.

types.name: AntiAliaserSettings
types.summary: Optional per-view AA controls shared by 2D and 3D pipelines.

types.name: BilinearUpscaler
types.summary: Resizes the supplied image using bilinear filtering.

types.name: ColorTransfer
types.summary: Output transfer functions for linear or display-encoded color.

types.name: Denoiser
types.summary: Per-view HDR denoising with spatial, temporal and optional neural backends. Raw tracer accumulation stays independent.

types.name: DenoiserMode
types.summary: Built-in spatial, temporal, and native denoising choices.

types.name: DenoiserOption
types.summary: Stable backend identifier and runtime capability information shown in settings.

types.name: FlatRenderer
types.summary: Zero-copy unlit output from any 2D or 3D geometry source.

types.name: Geometry
types.summary: Turns your 2D entities into the images lighting needs: what glows, what blocks light and how things move. Every entity with a Transform2D, a shape (Circle2D, Rectangle2D or Triangle2D) and a Material is drawn automatically. Add it to any lit 2D scene.

types.name: Geometry3D
types.summary: Unlit raster geometry buffers. Does not select a preview or present to the screen.

types.name: GeometryChannels
types.summary: Optional geometry buffers to generate alongside the primary color output.

types.name: HRCGI
types.summary: Holographic Radiance Cascades Global Illumination (HRCGI) for 2D shapes.

types.name: HRCToneMapper
types.summary: HRC/UDR update-phase adapter for the shared color processor. New render-phase pipelines use ToneMapper.

types.name: LightingReconstructor
types.summary: Reconstructs reduced-resolution diffuse lighting on full-resolution primary surfaces, after denoising.

types.name: MeshGeometry3D
types.summary: CPU scene extraction only. Shared by flat/raster geometry and the path tracer; no GPU targets.

types.name: MeshInstance
types.summary: Mesh, transform, and material data extracted from one ECS entity.

types.name: MouseLight
types.summary: Moves an emissive entity with the mouse in world coordinates.

types.name: Movement2DSystem
types.summary: Opt-in semi-implicit Euler movement; synchronizes spatial lookups after parallel integration.

types.name: Movement3DSystem
types.summary: Opt-in semi-implicit Euler movement; synchronizes spatial lookups after parallel integration.

types.name: OidnDenoiser
types.summary: Optional OIDN 2 neural backend. GPU access stays on the render thread; native inference runs on a worker.

types.name: OidnDevice
types.summary: Compute-device preferences for Open Image Denoise.

types.name: OidnQuality
types.summary: Quality presets passed to the Open Image Denoise backend.

types.name: PTGI
types.summary: Path-Traced Global Illumination (PTGI): accumulates diffuse lighting from a 2D or 3D triangle adapter.

types.name: PTGIBackend
types.summary: Selects the path tracer's GPU execution backend, not its lighting model.

types.name: PTGISettings
types.summary: Optional per-view path tracing controls, shared by perspective and orthographic adapters.

types.name: PaintBrush
types.summary: Paints ECS geometry along mouse strokes in world coordinates.

types.name: PerlinNoise2D
types.summary: Provides seeded gradient noise for procedural world generation.

types.name: PostAAMode
types.summary: Post-processing anti-aliasing techniques available to image stages.

types.name: RCGI
types.summary: Radiance Cascades Global Illumination (RCGI): experimental diffuse 3D lighting with dense world-space probes.

types.name: RCGISettings
types.summary: Optional per-view controls for a RCGI stage: probe density, directions, ray length and bounces.

types.name: RasterAAMode
types.summary: Geometry sampling modes for multisampling and supersampling.

types.name: RasterRenderer
types.summary: Applies directional diffuse lighting and ambient illumination to 2D or 3D raster input.

types.name: RasterSampler
types.summary: Per-view geometry sampling, independent of post AA. Share with the view's geometry adapters.

types.name: RenderInspector
types.summary: Per-view inspection. Buffer selection never changes any producer's output contract.

types.name: RenderPresenter
types.summary: Optional presentation. Independent instances may composite multiple views or target textures.

types.name: ShapeGeometry2D
types.summary: Opt-in opaque shape geometry for modular renderers. Existing HRC Geometry remains independent.

types.name: SvgfDenoiser
types.summary: Diffuse SVGF adaptation: reprojected history, luminance moments, variance and first-level wavelet feedback.

types.name: TileData
types.summary: Tile coordinates and type identifier stored on an ECS entity.

types.name: TileType
types.summary: Material, lighting, and display settings shared by a kind of tile.

types.name: TileTypeRegistry
types.summary: Looks up tile definitions by their stable identifier.

types.name: Tileset
types.summary: Renders and edits a tiled world with viewport caching and propagated lighting.

types.name: ToneMapOperator
types.summary: Tone curves used to map HDR radiance for display.

types.name: ToneMapper
types.summary: Dimension-independent exposure, tone mapping and output transfer. Does not present or own editor UI.

types.name: ToneMapperSettings
types.summary: Optional color controls for one view, owned by the scene Inspector.

types.name: TraceChannels
types.summary: Optional surface-guide buffers produced by the path tracer.

types.name: UDR1
types.summary: Reconstructs a color image spatially, with geometry-guided edge refinement and sharpening.

types.name: UDR2
types.summary: Reconstructs a color image and smooths it through temporal accumulation.

types.name: UDR3
types.summary: Reconstructs a color image with Lanczos filtering, edge refinement and temporal accumulation.

types.name: UDR4
types.summary: Reconstructs a color image with optional geometry and temporal guidance.

types.name: UDRQuality
types.summary: Controls the shared input-resolution preset for all UDR reconstruction algorithms.

types.name: Upscaler
types.summary: Reconstructs an image at display resolution using one selected UDR algorithm.

types.name: UpscalerMode
types.summary: Selects a UDR reconstruction algorithm, independently of the resolution preset.

types.name: WorldGenerator
types.summary: Populates the ECS with terrain and cave tiles derived from noise.

types.name: CoreSystemAttribute
types.summary: Marks engine infrastructure: hidden from the System Inspector so it can't be switched off by accident.

types.name: FrameTime
types.summary: Timing for the current callback. Multiply speeds by DeltaSeconds so motion is frame-rate independent.

types.name: PausableAttribute
types.summary: Lets the scene pause this system. Plain [Pausable] follows ECS.GameplayPaused; [Pausable(PauseGroup.Animation)] follows ECS.AnimationPaused.

types.name: PauseGroup
types.summary: Which pause switch affects a [Pausable] system. Combine values to respond to both.

types.name: RenderLayer
types.summary: Where a system's LateRender draws: World for scene content, Gameplay (the default) for game visuals, Overlay for debug drawing and UI for interface on top of everything.

types.name: RunAfterAttribute
types.summary: Runs this system after the listed systems, so it sees their results in the same frame.

types.name: RunBeforeAttribute
types.summary: Runs this system before the listed systems, so they see its results in the same frame.

types.name: Scene
types.summary: A level, menu or demo: one set of systems and entities with its own lifecycle. Subclass it, register systems in SetupECS, create entities in SetupScene, and hand it to GameClient.Run.

types.name: SceneServices
types.summary: Services belonging to one scene session. Retained services never retarget a new session.

types.name: System
types.summary: Game behavior that runs every frame. Override only the callbacks you need; the scene calls them in dependency order declared with [RunAfter] and [RunBefore].

types.name: SystemGroup
types.summary: A set of interchangeable systems where at most one runs at a time, such as alternative upscalers. Switching disposes the old system and initializes the new one.

types.name: SystemTagAttribute
types.summary: Adds categories, such as "2D" or "Rendering", that the System Inspector shows and filters by.
